{{- /* creator/tags.html — page → normalized tag list (strings, leading "#" dropped). Accepts YAML list or a single comma/space separated string. */ -}} {{- $out := slice -}} {{- with .Params.tags -}} {{- $list := . -}} {{- if not (reflect.IsSlice .) -}} {{- $list = split (replaceRE "[,\\s]+" "," (printf "%v" .)) "," -}} {{- end -}} {{- range $list -}} {{- $t := strings.TrimPrefix "#" (strings.TrimSpace (printf "%v" .)) -}} {{- if $t -}}{{- $out = $out | append $t -}}{{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* JSON string (Foundry stringifies non-string returns); callers pipe to transform.Unmarshal. */ -}} {{- $json := "[]" -}} {{- with $out -}}{{- $json = . | jsonify -}}{{- end -}} {{- return $json -}}
